rationale: Check round against fix-up diff (code-review-check.diff, 89 lines). One blocking finding from the final round: CR-001 (filterBy rendered-visibility test missing). Fix adds src/components/form/MultiSelect/__tests__/MultiSelect.filterBy.test.tsx — renders the real PrimeReact MultiSelect without mocking, types 'proj-tech-abc' into the filter input (matches option.value but NOT label or displayName), asserts Project Alpha visible and Project Beta absent. Uses vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.runAllTimers() to flush PrimeReact's internal useDebounce (setTimeout(fn, 0)) so filterState updates synchronously in the test. Test confirmed passing. CR-001 resolved. No new findings from the fix-up diff (test-only change, no production code touched, no security or API surface affected).
